problems.problem: Claude's models are not yet reliable or safe enough at perceiving and operating real software interfaces autonomously
evidence: Design and run experiments to improve Claude's perception and agentic capabilities
you'll work on advancing our models' ability to reliably and safely operate real software
problems.rationale: The need to run experiments to improve perception and agentic capabilities, and to advance reliable/safe operation, implies current model performance on computer use is insufficient.

problems.problem: The company lacks robust ways to measure whether models can actually complete complex computer tasks
evidence: Develop robust, reliable evaluation frameworks for measuring our models' ability to complete complex computer tasks
problems.rationale: Explicitly needing to 'develop' such frameworks indicates existing evaluation methods for agentic computer tasks are inadequate or missing.

problems.problem: Existing reinforcement learning training environments for computer use and vision tasks are insufficient or need improvement
evidence: Build and improve computer use and vision reinforcement learning training environments
problems.rationale: The instruction to 'build and improve' these environments shows current RL training environments for this domain are lacking or immature.

problems.problem: The company cannot yet reliably validate whether complex RL environments behave correctly before using them for training
evidence: Create pipelines and tools to test and validate complex RL environments
problems.rationale: Needing new pipelines/tools to test and validate RL environments implies no adequate validation infrastructure currently exists.

problems.problem: Coordination gaps exist between research teams and the production training/infrastructure stack, slowing improvements
evidence: Collaborate with teams across the model training and infrastructure stack to improve our production training setup
problems.rationale: The explicit call to collaborate across teams to improve the production training setup suggests the current setup and cross-team coordination need work.

problems.problem: Research advances in computer use are not translating quickly or smoothly into shipped product features
evidence: Partner with product teams to bring research advances into production
Your work will translate directly into model improvements in our own and our customers' products.
problems.rationale: The emphasis on partnering with product teams to bring research into production implies a gap between research output and product deployment that needs closing.

problems.problem: The company needs engineers skilled in long-horizon, sparse-reward RL and multimodal training, a specialized and scarce skill set, to advance agentic computer use
evidence: Experience with reinforcement learning, particularly in long-horizon or sparse-reward settings
problems.rationale: Listing these as preferred qualifications shows the team lacks sufficient specialized RL/multimodal expertise needed to solve its hardest technical challenges.
